# pi-slate

> Quiet vertical-first TUI for the Pi coding agent. Adds no new model-facing tools, prompts, or model calls.

Replaces Pi's header, footer, editor, and edit/write result rendering. Other extensions that replace the same surfaces or tool implementations may conflict.

Highlighted diffs use responsive split edits, unified writes, and character-level emphasis. They follow `/slate theme`. Native model-facing results are preserved; bounded write patches are stored in TUI result details for session restore.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): install, features, commands, themes, composer keys
- [Extension entry](extensions/pi-slate/index.ts): TUI replacement
- [Diff](extensions/pi-slate/diff.ts): edit/write rendering
- [Default theme](themes/black-metal.json): install default
- [Package manifest](package.json): `npm:pi-slate`
